correctness.rationale: The two complete and differently ordered finite enumerations agree on all 1,920 labeled Q4 four-colorings. Boundaries d=2 and d=4 handled.

value.rationale: The exact complete optimum set Q4 has a surprising structural split: 76/80 unlabeled optimal color partitions are nonlinear, despite canonical affine constructions and a known minimum palette size of four. This identifies the sharp first even-dimensional failure of affine rigidity and proves the phenomenon persists at arbitrarily high even dimension, giving a motivated classification boundary and construction.
